descriptor: Documentation platform for calm, findable guides

voice.summary: Sounds like a patient senior colleague pointing at a map: direct, kind and never flustered. It always says where you are and how to get back.
dos: Tell the reader where they are in one clause
Use plain verbs like open, go back and climb
donts: No jargon when a folder name will do
Avoid cute metaphors that hide the path
Never leave a dead end without a way back

taglines: Every page, one step from home
boilerplate: Fernwood Docs is a documentation platform for teams that want clear guides, predictable navigation and a visible trail from any page back to the start.

microcopy.success: Path updated. You are in Guides.
microcopy.error: We could not open that folder. Try the trail above.
microcopy.empty: This folder is empty. Go up a level to keep looking.

logo.note: Stacked chevrons read as a breadcrumb trail and as steps climbing back out.
